title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether Enforcement Measures May Be Taken against the Certificate Treasury Bonds Held by the Person Subject to Enforcement in Banks

articles.content_en:
Beijing Higher People's Court:
Your court's Request for Instructions on Whether Compulsory Measures of Freezing and Transferring May Be Taken against the Certificated Registered Treasury Bonds Deposited by the Person Subject to Enforcement in a Bank (Jing Gao Fa [1997] No. 194) has been received. Upon study, we reply as follows:
The certificated treasury bonds deposited by the person subject to enforcement in a bank are negotiable securities that are delivered by the person subject to enforcement to the bank for management and for which principal and interest are repaid upon maturity. In nature, they are similar to fixed-term savings deposits in banks and constitute property of the person subject to enforcement. In accordance with the spirit of the provisions of Article 242 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the People's Court may freeze and transfer the certificated treasury bonds deposited by the person subject to enforcement in a bank. The relevant bank shall, in accordance with the notice of assistance in enforcement of the People's Court, transfer the principal and interest to the applicant for enforcement.
This is the reply.
